description: Vault capture/recall lifecycle: inject the matched subgraph on SessionStart (plus a background ff-only pull and divergence/unswept-tail notices); Stop is SILENT by default (1.7.0) — it refreshes a spool record marked live with the session's claude pid as crash insurance, no model work (VAULT_STOP_CAPTURE=1 restores the in-session nag, re-armed every 30 min); PreCompact invalidates a stale sentinel without ever blocking; SessionEnd marks the record ended and launches a detached headless worker (spool-drain.sh) that mines the unswept tail — a nag the session never finished is NOT a sweep boundary; the drain never mines a record whose pid is a live claude; SessionStart relaunches stale records and lists only the ones auto-drain gave up on.
